EssaysView.purpose: Scan every essay draft and jump back in.
EssaysView.layout: Toolbar (count, New essay) over a single card of rows: school + programme chip, prompt clamped to 2 lines, meta (updated, words, review).

states.empty: ws-empty with one action (Start first essay)

EssayFormView.layout: Details card (school, programme, prompt), optional outline helper (collapsed), then a draft card: 70ch measure, 17px/1.7, sticky footer with live word and character count, Save draft, Cancel.
EssayFormView.notes: No invented word limits: the count is shown with a reminder to check the programme's official limit.

EssayDetailView.purpose: Read, review and version an essay.
EssayDetailView.layout: Action toolbar, prompt card, essay in a readable measure with word count, AI review card, version history as a scannable list (latest chip, date, score) plus diff.

ProfileView.layout: Summary card (initial avatar, name, email, essay count, sign out) then three form sections (About you, Admissions focus, Email) with helper text and a save row.
ProfileView.notes: No resume fields exist in this view; resume handling lives in the interview builder.

SettingsView.layout: Two-column sections (heading and help left, card right): Appearance, Workspace, Reminders, Feedback, Your data. Collapses to one column on tablet and phone.
SettingsView.dark: Switches and theme previews use tokens, so dark and light both work.

NotificationsView.layout: Toolbar with unread count and bulk actions; rows with severity dot, title, message, Open and Dismiss.

SetupGuide.layout: Accent-tinted card, next step, progress bar, collapsible steps.

AccountDataCard.layout: Two clearly labelled blocks; delete reveals a danger-bordered confirmation form.

dark_mode: Dark first; all colours from index.css tokens, no hard-coded greens.
